_comment: Shared pointers to this project's Notion knowledge base, read by ticket-pipeline so these pages are hardcoded in one place only. Companion to .claude/coding-style.json and .claude/kanban-cycle.json.

knowledge_base_page.description: Durable project context: what the shop is, the stack, the decisions that shape the work, and the environment caveats. The decisions log itself lives in decisions_database below.

decisions_database.description: One row per non-obvious architectural or domain decision, with a Status of Active, Superseded or Rejected. Written to by the ticket-pipeline curator on approval.

tech_debt_page.description: Running register of known technical debt. Assessments, not planned changes.

scoping_page.description: The original option analysis and the UK compliance notes, written before the project started. Read-only background. The decisions it left open are settled on the knowledge base page.
